_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : Research revenue (segment principal recurrent ~82% CA), Conferences (segment hypercroissance post-Covid), Consulting, CA total, Quota-bearing sales (sales capacity).

kpis.signal: Segment principal ~82% CA, modele subscription B2B premium, retention forte
kpis.description_fr: Segment Research : abonnements recherche IT (Magic Quadrants etc) + executive programs. ~82% CA Gartner FY24. Modele subscription B2B premium, base de la PV Gartner.
kpis.description_en: Research segment: IT research subscriptions (Magic Quadrants etc) + executive programs. ~82% Gartner revenue FY24. Premium B2B subscription model, Gartner's PV core.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance post-Covid (+386% sur 5 ans), retour conferences in-person + croissance organique
kpis.description_fr: Segment Conferences : conferences sectorielles IT executives (Gartner IT Symposium etc). Multiplie par ~5 depuis FY20 (post-Covid recovery + croissance organique).
kpis.description_en: Conferences segment: IT executive industry conferences (Gartner IT Symposium etc). ~5x since FY20 (post-Covid recovery + organic growth).

kpis.signal: Croissance moderee ~8-15%, margin lower que Research mais utile pour land-and-expand
kpis.description_fr: Segment Consulting : conseil IT/strategie, augmente la 'stickiness' clients Research. CAGR 5 ans ~8%.
kpis.description_en: Consulting segment: IT/strategy consulting, increases Research client stickiness. 5y CAGR ~8%.

kpis.signal: CAGR 5 ans +8.9%, ralentissement FY24 vs FY22-23 mais Research stable
kpis.description_fr: CA total Gartner = Research + Conferences + Consulting. Croissance FY24 ralentie a +6.1% (vs +15.7% FY22). Source 10-K MD&A.
kpis.description_en: Total Gartner revenue = Research + Conferences + Consulting. FY24 growth slowed to +6.1% (vs +15.7% FY22). Source 10-K MD&A.

kpis.signal: 5102 vendeurs FY24 (3804 GTS + 1298 GBS), +6% YoY, capacity de croissance Research
kpis.description_fr: Vendeurs quota-bearing au 31/12/2024 : 3804 Global Technology Sales (GTS) + 1298 Global Business Sales (GBS) = 5102 total. +6% YoY. Driver direct CV/CA Research.
kpis.description_en: Quota-bearing sales associates at 12/31/2024: 3804 Global Technology Sales (GTS) + 1298 Global Business Sales (GBS) = 5102 total. +6% YoY. Direct driver of CV/Research revenue.

_notes: Historique 5 ans FY20-FY24 pour Research/Conferences/Consulting/Total. Sales associates uniquement FY24 (historique non confirme sans risque d'invention). Sources : 10-K SEC Gartner 2022-2025 MD&A et notes Disaggregated Revenue.
